item.title: Death toll from building collapse in northern Lebanon rises to nine
item.description: The director general of civil defence says rescue teams pulled 15 people from the rubble, including six survivors.

item.title: China's Xi to visit US 'toward the end of the year:' Trump
item.description: The planned meeting signals fresh efforts by Washington and Beijing to manage tensions between the world’s two largest economies.

item.title: 'Flood' of disinformation ahead of Bangladesh election
item.description: Analysts say much of the disinformation targeting Bangladesh’s February 12 election is originating from India, which could distort voter perceptions.

item.title: Cuba halting airline refuelling as US pressure takes toll
item.description: Airlines flying to Cuba have been told they won’t be able to refuel for a month after US sanctions cut off Venezuelan oil supplies to the island.

item.title: Hong Kong court hands media tycoon Jimmy Lai 20-year sentence under security law
item.description: Lai, a British citizen born in mainland China, found guilty on all three counts, including "conspiring to collude with foreign forces" and conspiracy to publish seditious materials.

item.title: Japan stocks smash records as Takaichi landslide victory sparks market euphoria
item.description: Investors cheer political certainty in Tokyo, pushing the Nikkei past 57,000 as gains ripple across Asian markets.

item.title: Seahawks dominate Patriots 29–13 to win Super Bowl
item.description: The victory is buoyed by a dominant defencive display, and kicker Jason Myers' five field goals - the most ever by one player in a Super Bowl

item.title: South Korean army Cobra helicopter crash during drill kills two
item.description: Military grounds AH-1S fleet and launches investigation after deadly training accident near the North Korean border

item.title: Final rallies in Bangladesh as rivals vie to claim anti-Hasina uprising's legacy
item.description: With the February 12 vote days away, Bangladesh’s main opposition parties packed Dhaka streets, invoking the 2024 uprising that ousted Sheikh Hasina while pitching sharply different visions for the country’s future

item.title: Russian drones hit Odessa and Kharkiv, killing at least three amid peace push
item.description: In the Kharkiv region, state emergency services say they have recovered the bodies of a woman and a 10-year-old boy after a drone attack.
